verdict.rationale: x402 is a programmatic HTTP payment protocol with an SDK and APIs, so it can run without a UI. The docs describe backends consuming metered data and agents paying with no signups. A runtime probe confirmed the discovery API answers a plain keyless GET, and the SDK is published on public npm. Missing for 10: any documented CI/CD usage or guidance (pipelines, test environments, non-interactive credential setup for the 401-gated facilitator), plus independent hands-on reports of running x402 in automated pipelines.
